dataset: Victoria TIRTL Traffic Counts and Classification, October 2026
matching_method: Candidate OSM ways were inspected for one-way direction and geometry. Distances are exploratory only: TIRTL latitude/longitude fields were interpreted as geographic coordinates and projected locally, although the source does not declare datum/CRS or coordinate accuracy. Nearest-way distance alone is not accepted as a match.

confidence_scale.high_confidence: Independent installation/coverage evidence and direction agree with a unique network segment.
confidence_scale.medium_confidence: Multiple independent clues favor a candidate segment, but at least one material uncertainty remains; exploratory analysis only until resolved.
confidence_scale.low_confidence: Weak or conflicting evidence; excluded from primary validation.
confidence_scale.unresolved: No defensible segment assignment can be made.

mappings.reported_heading_evidence: The independent 2026-10-12 sample contains heading E and one record with W; full-month heading audit is not available.

decision: No detector mapping is sufficiently confirmed for primary SUMO validation. Site 505 may be used only for clearly labeled exploratory work; site 504 remains unresolved.
evidence_needed_to_upgrade: DTP-confirmed CRS/datum and positional accuracy for site coordinates.
Detector installation plan or authoritative statement identifying road carriageway and covered lanes.
Documented meaning of TIRTL heading values and resolution of contrary headings.
Versioned West Gate SUMO network and independent verification that its detector measurement section matches the physical installation.
